success_definition.audience_success: A cold viewer immediately recognizes the relationship behavior and wants to tag the partner who also says every package was necessary.
success_definition.creative_success: The deck works as silent panels: parcels at the door, two defensive statements, one repeated doorbell, two guilty faces, shared hiding, earned alibi payoff.
success_definition.brand_success: Warm, funny, desi married-life IP with small behavior as proof of love, not polished AI romance.
success_definition.production_success: Pass Layer E, Golden Theme, Story Director, stage-scene, post-copy visual room, visual debate, identity, native 4:5, native 9:16, QA, and final audit gates before final.
